title: 🛖 Onchain Art Hub - Culture Is the Crop, Why Onchain Art Matters
description: Ethereum is more than technology; it’s a movement, and movements survive through the culture people build around them. This talk explores how onchain art preserves that culture and opens a door for newcomers, and why we should support it in every market, so we can nurture, protect, and grow this space in the right direction.
